propositions: A local commit-msg hook rejects commits whose subject exceeds 50 columns or whose body has any line over 72 columns, naming each offending line and its length.
The checker is check-only and never rewrites the commit message.
Gerrit's own commit-msg Change-Id hook is preserved as commit-msg.legacy via pre-commit migration mode so conforming commits still receive their Change-Id trailer.

Body lines are exempt from the 72-column check for trailers, TAG= lines, fenced code blocks, 4+ space or tab indented blocks, table rows, and single unsplittable atomic tokens like URLs/paths/dotted identifiers.
default_install_hook_types installs both pre-commit and commit-msg hooks, and make hooks exits non-zero if a hook file is missing and warns (exit zero) if no Change-Id stamping is found.
Enforcement is a bypassable local guardrail only (not CI) and applies to new commits, leaving existing history unrewritten.
